title: Perpetual Preferred Against Bitcoin Backtest
notes: If you use this repository, please cite the paper: Fairbanks (2026), Perpetual Preferred Equity Against Bitcoin: Required Coverage Across Observed Drawdowns. DOI 10.2139/ssrn.7201678.
description:
Replication artifact for the paper "Perpetual Preferred Equity Against Bitcoin: Required Coverage Across Observed Drawdowns" (Fairbanks, 2026). Paper: https://ssrn.com/abstract=7201678 (DOI: 10.2139/ssrn.7201678).

The paper measures the Bitcoin Coverage Ratio (BCR = BTC reserve value / annual dividend obligation) at which a stripped-model perpetual preferred issuer clears observed Bitcoin drawdowns across four real BTC drawdown regimes (April 2013, Mt. Gox 2014, ICO Unwind 2018, Fed Tightening 2022), a 2011 supplementary regime, and a bundled COVID 2020 reference regime, sweeping 245 starting-BCR values per regime at 0.1x resolution.

This repository bundles the canonical solvency engine, the export pipeline, the two raw price sources, and the published output CSVs.
